content.title: Is It Too Late To Consider USA Compression Partners After Strong Multi Year Price Gains?

The units have pulled back 4.2% over the last week, but they are still up 1.9% over 30 days, 15.6% over the past year and 222.0% over five years, which naturally raises questions about what kind of value is left on the table. Recently, investors have been focusing on USA Compression Partners’ continued role in supporting US natural gas infrastructure...
